decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core candle-arch craft that was highlighted on the home page in both 2018 and 2019, it appears to have proven demand and is inexpensive to retain in the assortment.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid fits the firm's established strengths, received repeated front-page promotion, and should remain a low-uncertainty, low-risk product to keep selling.
The electronic music box stayed prominent for two years and underpins later add-on motifs, so keeping the base platform preserves upside in the electronic line at limited additional cost.
Although a second edition was introduced, this is still a narrow and more distant themed add-on, and by 2022 the experiment has likely revealed enough to reallocate effort to stronger core products.

This seasonal electronic motif platform looks like a useful test product but not a core handcrafted line, and the limited evidence of continued expansion suggests its option value is largely exhausted.

The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's proven craftsmanship, was promoted on the home page in both years observed, and offers differentiated appeal with little strategic downside.
